steps.en: Officer opens the upload page as an alternative to search
steps.id: Petugas membuka halaman upload sebagai alternatif pencarian

steps.en: Officer uploads the list as a CSV file
steps.id: Petugas meng-upload daftar dalam file CSV
steps.why_en: Only Excel files are accepted; CSV files are not.
steps.why_id: Hanya file Excel yang diterima, file CSV tidak.

steps.en: File is read into rows with notice numbers
steps.id: File dibaca menjadi baris berisi nomor notice

steps.en: Each row is looked up and matching notices are collected
steps.id: Tiap baris dicari dan notice yang cocok dikumpulkan
Notice hasil upload tampil di layar
